# Module: `icescopy_inptk_panel`

Provides the INP analysis window, its preferences widget, and analysis history.

[Source](../src/icescopy_inptk_panel.py) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

Coordinates sample groups, blank selection, temperature limits, count previews, toolkit requests, plots, and exports. Combined calculations and direct individual concentrations are requested from the external toolkit. The window keeps separate undo/redo history and saves analysis choices and results with the Icescopy session.

## Classes

| Class | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [`InpSettingsCommand`](API-Class-InpSettingsCommand.md) | Restores before/after analysis choices through the panel's undo stack. |
| [`RangeLimitDelegate`](API-Class-RangeLimitDelegate.md) | Displays available endpoints as placeholders in temperature-limit cells. |
| [`InptkPreferencesWidget`](API-Class-InptkPreferencesWidget.md) | Lets users choose and test a separately installed toolkit executable. |
| [`InptkPanel`](API-Class-InptkPanel.md) | Manages the analysis window and its current inputs, choices, and results. |
